verdict.rationale: Unit's docs claim payment capabilities including ACH (send and receive) with settlement-level visibility, accessible through its APIs, and a Webhook Events docs page exists. However, nothing in the pack details how ACH origination works or covers the unhappy-path modeling the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit ACH credit and debit origination via API, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as first-class objects, ACH-specific webhook events, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
